Perplexity Computer can create world-class artifacts. Here’s an interactive 3D physics textbook.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-11-26T20:49:34+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2126055785860137135; média: videó, 90 másodperc]
Perplexity made an introductory physics textbook with interactive 3D illustrations.

The interactive components are built in Three.js, rendering text and illustrations onto Canvas textures. Perplexity used Playwright to drive the interactions frame by frame, and FFmpeg to encode the 60fps walkthrough video.
